in_marathi.name: Dl
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dl हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dl is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Dewata' which means 'God'. It is a unisex name and is commonly used in Hindu culture. The name Dl is believed to bring luck and protection to the bearer.
